problems.statement: The Feb 2026 supervisor bonus penalty per deviation report created a perverse incentive that suppressed deviation reporting, so zero deviations reflects non-reporting, not zero defects.

Line 3's 118% attainment is not a transferable best practice: it is inflated by undocumented borrowed labour from Lines 1 and 4 (which lost attainment), with per-technician-hour productivity unchanged.

Line 3 is concealing leaking or mis-bonded units through off-record rework (unrecorded in the device history record), which is a probable data-integrity and regulatory problem; the allegation is anonymous but corroborated.
Quality is actually deteriorating and defects are escaping to customers, concentrated in Line 3 luer bond leaks.
The plant's governance failed: the hotline allegation was closed by the Plant Manager, who is conflicted, without investigation, and the pulse survey shows a fear-based climate.
The underlying Line 3 bonding process problem (cure-time variability) was never fixed, as the CAPA is still open and there is no process change.
The first-pass quality training program caused the drop in deviations (Quality Manager's claim).
Line 3's huddles, 5S and supervisor culture explain its superior performance and can be rolled out (Plant Manager's and Supervisor's account).
The lower-cost tubing supplier change explains the rise in leaks and purchasing.

causalClaims.to: Collapse in deviation reports to zero
Luer bond leaks at Line 3 and customer complaints
Off-record rework and informal labour lending

causalClaims.from: Plant Manager's closure of hotline case without investigation

actions.action: Decline to roll Line 3 out as the plant template and do not credit it as best practice.
actions.rationale: Its output is explained by undocumented borrowed labour and probably hidden rework, so copying it would spread the problem.

actions.action: Suspend the deviation-linked supervisor bonus deduction immediately and replace it with incentives that do not penalise reporting.
actions.rationale: It is the plausible root cause of suppressed reporting and its removal does not depend on confirming the rework allegation.

actions.action: Reopen hotline case 2026-031 under an independent investigator outside the Plant Manager's chain, such as corporate or Regulatory: records review, back-cage walk-through, material usage, and DHR audit.
actions.rationale: The first closure was conflicted and had no records review, and the allegation concerns device history record integrity.

actions.action: Notify Regulatory Affairs and the quality-system owner and evaluate customer notification, containment and complaint or field-action obligations for Line 3 luer-bond lots.
actions.rationale: Complaints are rising and leaks at the luer bond joint trace to Line 3, which creates patient-safety and regulatory exposure.

actions.action: Reconcile purchasing, scrap and adhesive usage and badge data by line, and formally record labour lending.
actions.rationale: This quantifies the hidden rework and borrowed labour cheaply.

actions.action: Close the open CAPA-2025-117 by fixing bonding cure-time variability on all lines.
actions.rationale: It addresses the real documented process cause independent of the concealment question.

actions.action: Protect staff from retaliation and give them a non-supervisor channel to report, and review the night-shift moves.
actions.rationale: Pulse survey and interviews show fear of speaking up.

actions.action: Discipline or terminate the Line 3 supervisor now.
actions.rationale: The allegation is uncorroborated by records so far and an investigation should come first.

actions.action: Expand the first-pass quality training as the fix, or celebrate zero deviations publicly.
actions.rationale: Training did not cause the drop in deviations, and celebrating zero deviations reinforces a misleading metric.

actions.action: Switch back to the old tubing supplier.
actions.rationale: The supplier difference is trivial and does not explain the leaks.

nextEvidence: Independent audit of the Line 3 back cage and device history records, comparing adhesive and connector consumption and rework against recorded units
Line-level traceability of rework and scrap by lot, and reconciliation of the 30% rise in replacement-component purchases to the lines
Interviews of technicians and Line 3 second shift with retaliation protection, and who directed labour lending and the NCR night-shift moves
output.summary: Zero deviations is a measurement artifact. The Feb 2026 bonus penalty per deviation made reporting costly. Reports vanished while customer complaints (11 to 31 ppm), final-inspection rejections, replacement-component purchases and survey fear all rose. Line 3's 118% is explained by borrowed Line 1 and 4 technicians, with unchanged productivity, plus probable unrecorded rework of luer-bond leaks. The training program, huddles and tubing supplier do not explain it. Do not roll Line 3 out as a template. Remove the penalty, reopen the hotline case independently, engage Regulatory, contain Line 3 lots and fix the open bonding CAPA.
